title: Content import document
description: A body of existing content for one site: content types, categories, tags and entries with their language versions. Read by `manage.py sites_import_content`.

source.description: A name for where the content comes from. Ids are unique within it, and a later document with the same `source` updates what this one brought.

organization.description: The slug of the organization the document is for. The command refuses a document for another organization than the one its operator named.

default_locale.description: The site's own language; must equal the site's.

types.description: Content types the entries go into. An existing type is found by `key` and left as it is; a missing one is made (the deployment's offer and the plan's limit apply) and needs `name` and `base_path`.

base_path.description: The type's name in addresses of the site's language.

additionalProperties.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

locale_paths.description: Its name in addresses of other languages.

schema_type.description: What an entry is to search engines.

categories.description: Categories of a type, a parent before what is under it (three levels at most).

id.description: The object's id where it comes from; unique in its list, stable between runs.

type.description: The key of its content type.

parent.description: The `id` of the category above it; null at the top.

names.description: The name per language code; the site's own language is required. A name is kept as a person's text: the translation engine never overwrites it.

additionalProperties.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

slugs.description: The archive's address per language. A language left out gets its address from the name in that language (or follows the site's language where it has no name).

items.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

former_slugs.description: Slugs this object answered under before — the last part of an old address, never a whole path. Each answers one 308 to today's address.

tags.description: Tags of the site, shared by its content types.

id.description: The object's id where it comes from; unique in its list, stable between runs.

names.description: The name per language code; the site's own language is required. A name is kept as a person's text: the translation engine never overwrites it.

additionalProperties.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

slugs.description: The archive's address per language. A language left out gets its address from the name in that language (or follows the site's language where it has no name).

items.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

former_slugs.description: Slugs this object answered under before — the last part of an old address, never a whole path. Each answers one 308 to today's address.

id.description: The object's id where it comes from; unique in its list, stable between runs.

type.description: The key of its content type.

categories.description: Ids of categories of its type; every language version is filed under them.

tags.description: Ids of tags; every language version carries them.

source_locale.description: The language the others were translated from; left out, the site's own.

versions.description: The entry in each language it has: one translation group. A language is given once.

slug.description: The last part of the entry's address. Left out: made from the title (a Cyrillic title is written in Latin letters), unique in the type and language.

items.description: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens.

former_slugs.description: Slugs this object answered under before — the last part of an old address, never a whole path. Each answers one 308 to today's address.

html.description: HTML, turned into blocks by the core's converter. Every loss is reported.

blocks.description: Core blocks (`block_type`, `schema_version`, `data`). A picture is named by `"asset_id": "file:<path>"`.

file.description: Path of a JPEG, PNG or WebP file, relative to the document's directory. No absolute path and nothing outside that directory.

cover.description: A picture shown first in the body (HTML bodies): what lists and shared links show of the entry.

file.description: Path of a JPEG, PNG or WebP file, relative to the document's directory. No absolute path and nothing outside that directory.

images.description: For an HTML body: the file for each `` of the HTML, by that `src` exactly. An image without one is reported as lost.

status.description: The import publishes what says `published` and nothing else; it never withdraws.

published_at.description: The date readers, feeds and structured data show as the publication date (with a zone). Required for `published`; never in the future.

changed_at.description: When this text last changed where it comes from: the page's „updated”, the sitemap's `lastmod`, `dateModified`. Left out: `published_at`.

origin.description: Who wrote this version's texts, unless a field says otherwise. A version with any `ai` field is marked as machine text to search engines.
Who wrote this field: a person, a model, or nobody vouches (`import`). Left out: the version's `origin`.

sha256.description: This text's own fingerprint, as whoever prepared the document computed it. On a source version it is what translations' `source_sha256` are compared with; left out, the import computes SHA-256 of the field's UTF-8 text exactly as the document holds it (`body`: the `html` string, or the blocks as JSON with sorted keys and no spaces).

source_sha256.description: For a translated field: the fingerprint of the source text it was made from. Kept as given. When it differs from the source version's fingerprint the translation is reported as stale.

fields.description: Per field — `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, or any other name the source has — its origin and fingerprints. Fields the core does not hold are kept for the record.

accept_losses.description: Kinds of content the HTML converter may lose in this version without holding it back from publication (the kinds are named in the report).
